title: Customer and Messenger Handover Readiness — Temporary QR Test Revision
objective: Fix the confirmed mobile customer-menu defects and complete the repository and Messenger workflow contracts needed for a safe customer handover, while preserving authoritative order identity and the reviewed payment-proof flow.
goal: Customers can browse or order on mobile and complete the Messenger order-to-payment-slip journey without manual total entry, identity guessing, welcome replay, duplicate proof rows, or owner intervention.
context: ATLAS-005 and ATLAS-006 are complete, ATLAS-007 self-pilot usability passed, and main is clean at 393e55800caee98c7bddf4ea1efa81591f9e0917. Confirmed repository defects: iPhone/Safari can hide the focused dine-in table or notes field behind the keyboard, and the success screen top-right X remains disabled because the submitting state stays true while the bottom Close action works. Existing shared menu data lives in src/data/menu.ts and MenuScreen is shared by / and /m; browse-only mode must extend that screen rather than copy menu data. Existing authoritative order automation already resolves a completed bot_session by order id, returns exact subtotal/delivery fee/total and externalChatId through /api/automation/order-details, and exposes the public PAYMENT_QR_URL contract. Existing payment intake accepts an explicitly mapped order number and enforces one pending proof per order. Connected n8n inspection found two active workflows: Atlas Messenger Webhook Receiver (STAGING), id 5BKEgw3dcsEJoA3X, and Atlas Order Automation Receiver, id 5rnFuyKkFHzmYPZt. The Messenger receiver currently sends the three-option greeting for qualifying messages in parallel with its image-proof branch, so a slip image can replay the greeting; it looks up the exact channel plus external_chat_id mapping and requires exactly one row. The order receiver fetches authoritative order details and upserts that exact mapping but currently sends no confirmation, exact total, or QR. Messenger button templates permit only three buttons, so do not raise the provider limit to four; use a provider-valid presentation that visibly offers Place an Order, Menu, Location, and Opening Time. The app webhook currently strips arbitrary text and postback payloads; if postback routing is needed, forward only a closed allowlist of known actions. No approved QR asset was found in the repository and connected Vercel tooling cannot prove PAYMENT_QR_URL presence. V2 must verify the approved production PAYMENT_QR_URL configuration before implementation or stop and ask for the real approved asset/config. Do not invent a QR URL or image. n8n modifications are external Class B actions: investigate and propose through V2, then stop for the exact action approval before any update or publish. Never send a real customer message during verification. The user supplied one SCB PromptPay PNG outside the repository and explicitly approved it only as a temporary ATLAS-008 test payment QR, never as the final restaurant QR. Approved fixture path: C:\Users\User\Downloads\Codex Image Aug 26, 2026, 11_34_33 AM.png. Approved fixture SHA-256: 080B3DAFC1661D04D96922CC4097ADAE487F5AE482FEDF4E314E1403491B0BBF. Do not decode, transcribe, log or persist a payment identifier from the image. Do not copy the asset into product source, commit it, deploy it, or configure it as the final production QR. It may be supplied as an external test fixture or temporary approved HTTPS test asset only to prove that the authoritative total is followed by an image message. The real restaurant-approved QR remains a mandatory handover blocker.

stoppingRules: Use only the exact temporary QR fixture whose SHA-256 is recorded in this task; do not decode/log its payment identifier, copy it into committed product files, deploy it, or treat it as the final restaurant QR.
Do not duplicate src/data/menu.ts, menu items, prices, availability logic, cart logic or checkout logic.
Do not weaken the bot-session/order identity binding, select an order by recency, or accept an ambiguous chat-order mapping.
Do not weaken, rewrite or bypass the reviewed payment-proof intake/review flow.
Do not create duplicate proof rows or directly mark a Messenger proof order paid.
Do not confuse staff-verified dine-in Transfer with customer Messenger payment proof.
Do not expand Messenger provider limits beyond their documented maximum; choose a compliant presentation.
Stop before any n8n workflow update, publish, production config change, deployment, customer message, real order/payment action or schema change and surface the exact action-specific approval.
Use only production-safe test identities and never message a real customer without separate explicit approval.
Do not expose credential values, chat identifiers, tokens, webhook URLs containing secrets or customer data.
Fix only obvious unfinished or confusing text within these flows; do not redesign the menu or staff/owner interfaces.
Stop if a required change falls outside allowedPaths or requires database schema changes.
Stop if the same failure repeats twice without new evidence.
Stop and escalate after two unsuccessful revision rounds.
Before any production handover, stop until the real restaurant-approved QR asset/config replaces the temporary test fixture.
